title: Cook County budget approved
body: Cook County commissioners approved a balanced budget after a public hearing, preserving road and school funding for the coming year.

title: Lakeview school expansion
body: Lakeview school leaders announced a classroom expansion and construction schedule for local families.

title: Ambiguous county note
body: Pineville and Lakeview leaders discussed a regional project without identifying a single jurisdiction in the notice.
